protocol.algorithm: official PQN, observation mask augmentation only
protocol.mask_distribution: per training episode independently intact/R/G/B erased each with 25% probability
protocol.source_train_rights: trained on all three known missing-channel corruption families, unlike post-failure source model
protocol.method_class: standard channel dropout domain randomization, not novel
protocol.closest_reference: Skand et al. 2025 Simple Masked Training Strategies Yield Control Policies That Are Robust to Sensor Failure
protocol.evaluation: independent native simulator trajectories, intact/masked raw RGB
